title: Wood Frog: Barf Mein Zinda Rehne Wala Mendhak!
idea: The wood frog can survive winter by allowing up to 70% of its body water to freeze completely solid for over 190 days.

lines.text: Kya ek mendhak poori tarah barf bankar bhi zinda reh sakta hai?
Wood frog sardi mein apne body ka 70 percent paani freeze kar leta hai!
Is state mein iska dil, saans aur blood circulation sab ruk jaata hai.
Yeh anokha mendhak poore 193 dino tak frozen rehta hai!
Lekin garmi aate hi barf pighalti hai aur yeh dobara zinda ho jaata hai!
Kya aap itni sardi mein ek din bhi survive kar paoge?

facts.claim: Wood frog can tolerate freezing of 65-70% of total body water
Frozen wood frogs have no heartbeat or breathing
Wood frogs remain frozen for around 193 days during hibernation
